name: Meet Tab Sidecar
summary: Chrome extension for joining a Meet while a sidecar tab handles audio, intros, or presentation work.
story: Meetings should produce a useful artifact, not just another happening. This lets another tab do the repeatable work while I stay focused on the conversation.
